tools.name: explain_reason
tools.description: Explains a SignupBouncer reason code (for example disposable_domain, burner_mx, repeat_inbox, datacenter_ip): what it means, how many points it adds or whether it blocks alone, and the lowest plan on which it counts. Without a code, lists every code.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "integration_guide" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Returns the steps and the copy-paste code that checks new signups with SignupBouncer in one stack: supabase (a hook, no code), ory (a web hook, no code), fetch …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_email, lookup_burner_domain, get_rules · Private data: integration_guide, get_rules, update_rules · Public sink: check_email, lookup_burner_domain, update_rules.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_email, lookup_burner_domain, get_rules · Private data: integration_guide, get_rules, update_rules · Public sink: check_email, lookup_burner_domain, update_rules

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
